_meta.description: Hardcoded bias corrections for GWW3 Sprint 3 MVP. Consumed by ETL Bias Tagger + Correction Overlay steps.

worldbank-wdi.note: Nations self-report to WB/IMF. Default confidence for countries with adequate statistical capacity.

worldbank-wdi-low-capacity.note: Applied to nations with WB Statistical Capacity Score < 60 (Sub-Saharan Africa, fragile states). See Jerven 2013.

freedom-house.note: 86% US government funded (2016). Liberal-democratic conceptual frame as universal standard. Bush 2017.

v-dem.note: 4000+ experts, documented pessimism bias (Wig et al. 2024). Best available governance source despite limitations.

v-dem-contested.note: Applied to nations where V-Dem classification is actively contested (e.g., India as 'electoral autocracy').

acled.note: Terrorism defined exclusively via non-state actors. Media-dependent sourcing. Undercounting in conflict zones.

acled-conflict-zone.note: Applied per Penalty Stacking Rubric: access_constraint(0.40) + media_filter(0.55) → c=0.475, rounded to 0.50.

un-wpp.note: Generally reliable demographic source. Country-specific overrides below for known issues.

sipri-milex.note: Nations self-report defense spending. Some states (e.g., CHN, SAU) may underreport.

global-firepower.note: Web-scraped composite index. No peer review. Useful for force structure, not for precision.

population.rationale: Yi Fuxian (2013): systematic overcount of 90-130M due to local incentive inflation + One-Child Policy underreporting. Conservative 100M reduction applied.

gdp_nominal.rationale: China's NBS has documented history of adjusting GDP figures. Night-light proxies suggest ~12% overcount (Martinez 2022). No value correction applied yet — confidence downgrade only.

military_spending_abs.rationale: SIPRI estimates CHN spending at 1.5-2x official figures. Significant off-budget items (R&D, paramilitary, space). Confidence downgrade only.

gdp_nominal.rationale: No reliable GDP data exists. All figures are estimates by external agencies (CIA, Bank of Korea). Near uniform noise.

military_spending_abs.rationale: Wartime spending since 2022 partially classified. SIPRI revises upward. Confidence downgrade only.
Saudi defense procurement often off-budget. SIPRI methodology note.

derived_metrics._doc: Ordered list of derived metrics for the Re-Derive step. Process sequentially (DAG order: base metrics first).
